children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 10, 2026) - Gold Runner Exploration Inc.
(FSE: CE70)
Gold Runner
" or the "
Company

") is pleased to announce that it has completed processing and interpretation of the airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys conducted on the Golden Girl property (the "Property") in the Golden Triangle of British Columbia. Due to the positive survey results, as well as exploration efforts on the ground, the Company has actively chosen to stake additional claims in the area and has more than doubled the size of the Golden Girl Property from 5,873 hectares ("ha") to 14,480 ha.

The newly staked claims cover additional large areas of recent glacial retreat and permanent snowpack abatement between the original claim boundaries centered around the newly discovered Gold Stack Trend and the past producing Snip Mine. Multiple new exploration targets within the expanded claims have been identified with the help of magnetic and radiometric anomalies determined with the recently concluded geophysical survey. Initial prospecting, mapping and systematic sampling has been carried out on a number of these new showings with the goal of adding potential drill targets for the upcoming inaugural drill program scheduled for the summer of 2027. The new claims have been duly filed, registered, and submitted for approval.

The Company's successful 2026 exploration program focused on prospecting, systematic sampling and mapping of new and historic showings in preparation for drilling. During the program a total of 473 samples were collected (290 grab samples, 122 channel samples, and 61 silt samples). Assays are pending on 413 samples collected. In addition to the airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys, the company also completed a unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry and LiDAR survey on the Golden Girl Property which among other things will help identify the extent of mineralization and facilitate 3D modeling as exploration progresses through successive future drilling campaigns.

Gold Runner's Chief Executive Officer, Chris Wensley, states, "In the face of such encouraging data from both our geophysics efforts and what we're seeing on the ground, it became immediately apparent that acquiring the adjoining claims at Golden Girl was imperative. The additional claims, once approved, will more than double the Company's footprint in this highly prospective ground extending from Snip to the Alaska/B.C. border. We are very keen and excited to learn more about what these additional claims, and the entire Golden Girl Property, hold. This lays a strong foundation for years of exploration and development to come."

Golden Girl Property Highlights:
The Golden Girl Property covers 14,480 ha in the prolific Iskut River region of Northwestern British Columbia, located just 17 km from the Snip Mine and 14 km from the Bronson Airstrip.
Discovery exploration in 2024 identified a major new gold-silver system measuring 12 km by 7 km with high grade gold-silver mineralization:
Grab samples assayed up to 11.28 g/t Au, 3,262 g/t Ag, 5.37% Cu, 20% Pb, and 14% Zn.
Channel cuts assayed up to 3.74 g/t Au, 2,105.45 g/t Ag, 0.88% Cu, 5.48% Pb, and 7.42% Zn.

Multiple new gold-silver mineralized zones have been identified during the 2026 exploration season, including the Gold Stack Trend which has a strike of 350 metres ("m") and contains samples with grades up to 396.66 g/t AuEq (11.22 g/t Au, 25,306 g/t Ag, 2.96% Cu, 8.19% Pb, and 5.89% Zn) and remains open (see the Company's news release dated August 31, 2026).

High-grade mineralization occurs in structurally controlled shear zones with sulphide-rich veins, stockwork, and breccias, similar to the nearby past-producing Snip Gold Mine (which historically produced ~1M oz Au, 390k oz Ag, and over 249k kg Cu). The reader is reminded that the information provided herein from neighbouring projects and properties is not necessarily indicative of resources and should not be relied upon for the determination of mineralization or potential results of the Company's properties.

More than 95% of the Property has never undergone systematic modern exploration. Recent rapid glacial retreat and melting snowpacks have exposed vast areas of previously buried bedrock, opening large, untouched tracts of ground for immediate mapping and sampling.

About Gold Runner Exploration Inc.

Gold Runner Exploration is an exploration company focused on the exploration and development of its portfolio of gold and silver properties located in prolific mining districts of Canada and the United States of America. In British Columbia, Gold Runner holds the option to acquire a 100% interest in the Golden Girl Property, located in the prolific Golden Triangle of Northwestern British Columbia. In North Central Nevada, the Company holds the Rock Creek gold project, the Falcon Mine project and the Dry Creek project, located in the Tuscarora Mountains in close proximity to the world-renowned Carlin Trend. Gold Runner also holds a 10% carried interest in the Cimarron project located in the San Antonio Mountains of Nye County, Nevada, within the Walker Lane Trend.
About B-ALL Syndicate Ltd.

The B-ALL Syndicate is a highly specialized geologic team of project generators with a proven track record of success. The Syndicate is focused in unexplored areas of glacial and snowpack retreat providing new opportunity for material discovery in renowned geologic terrain. Projects generated by the same team include Goliath Resources' Surebet discovery on the Golddigger Property, Juggernaut Exploration's Big One discovery as well as multiple additional material discoveries.
